positions.name: MigrationDecisionTerms
positions.frame: what are the terms of the QuantumDB migration decision — target system, performance rationale, and timeline?
positions.why: src-1 is the raw declarative announcement of the switch; src-2, src-3, src-4 are the same decision broken into its constituent terms (what changes, why, and when). Read together they describe one decision's scope rather than four separate claims — the structured bullets restate and decompose the same statement src-1 makes, so a single directional read (the decision's terms) spans all four.
